description: This file implements an OpenAI-like chat completion handler with both asynchronous and synchronous methods. It includes functionality for making API calls, handling responses, streaming completions, error handling, and integration with various provider configurations. The class `OpenAILikeChatHandler` extends a base class to provide chat completion capabilities compatible with OpenAI's API style, along with custom streaming and response handling.
